limitations: Cloud Chromium/SwiftShader functional tests; not Galaxy A51 evidence.
A superseded tab stops GPU draw submission before the replacement launch; its state/storage and the tested tab renderer remain unchanged.
Normal UI start/scenario selection may position an aircraft at its configured spawn; tests label such starts. No lifecycle is inferred from teleporting aircraft state.
Replay save protection is tested by a deliberate real savePrefs(true) call after a rendered replay frame, not by firing the natural autosave timer.
Replay stop is observed synchronously using a wrapper that calls the original function unchanged, before any later live physics step.
No Android installation, gyro, battery or thermal claim.

replayRecordingFixture.method: Fresh normal Start New with HUMID VAPOUR RUN selected in the scenario dropdown, actual C cockpit key and AP toolbar button. Cockpit mode matches the preceding version of this fixture. Built-in scenario supplies altitude/speed; no rigid-state assignment. This is a replay/restoration fixture, not evidence of a flown takeoff.

replayDoubleClickEvidence.method: Capture/bubble listeners bracket the unchanged real UI handler in one event task. An active replay ignores a second request; a request after natural completion may start a new replay.

replayEvidence.method: Real recorded frames and keyboard pitch input; actual UI replay button; capture-phase Replay UI listener and unchanged-call stop wrapper capture synchronous pre-start and post-stop state. No camera input follows pre-start capture. Natural completion is observed before the next live physics step. Geometry assertions independently rotate canonical axes by the rigid quaternion.
